name: led-jnj-2835-deepred
description: JNJ JNJ-L-2835CW-66018-S-G1 2835 deep red LED, 660 nm dominant, rated 20 mA in the catalogue (IF max 300 mA per datasheet), Vf 1.8 V at 20 mA (~1.9 V at 60 mA, extrapolated), 125 deg, 4 cd (LCSC C22447975)

vf_trim.description: forward-voltage offset in volts for this LED (bin/part spread); the series source V<ref>_trim also measures the LED current: probe i(V<ref>_trim)
